Integrations/Communication

Roam

Roam HQ provides APIs for secure messaging, chat, file sharing, and collaboration with enterprise-grade security and compliance features.

39 actionsSign in with Roam

Connect Roam

What your bot can do in Roam

Looks up

  • Get Address InfoGet information about a chat address, which is the name for any entity that may participate in a chat, such as a user, visitor, or bot.
  • Get meeting linkGet a meeting link.
  • Get SCIM schemaRetrieves the definition of a specific SCIM 2.0 schema by its unique identifier (URN).
  • Get chat historyLists messages in a chat, filtered by date range (after/before).
  • Get Roam SCIM Resource TypesReturns the list of SCIM 2.0 resource types supported by Roam.
  • Get SCIM service provider configRetrieve Roam's SCIM service provider configuration.
  • Get token infoRetrieves information about the current Roam access token.
  • Get user by ID (SCIM)Retrieve a single user by their Roam Person ID using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Get user infoGet detailed information about a single user in your Roam workspace.
  • List group membersList members in a group in your Roam workspace.
Show 12 more
  • List Roam ChatsLists all accessible chats, which consist of all DMs, MultiDMs, and Channels that your bot has been added to, in addition to all public…
  • List Roam LobbiesLists active lobbies in your Roam account.
  • List Roam MeetingsLists all meetings in your home Roam, filtered by date range.
  • List Roam RecordingsList all recordings in your home Roam.
  • List Roam TranscriptsLists all transcripts in your Roam workspace, filtered by date range.
  • List SCIM GroupsReturns a paginated list of groups in your Roam organization via SCIM 2.0.
  • List SCIM SchemasList all SCIM 2.0 schemas supported by Roam.
  • List User Audit LogGet a list of user audit log entries for the account.
  • List UsersList all users in the Roam workspace.
  • List users (SCIM)List users in your Roam organization using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Lookup user by emailLook up a user in your Roam workspace by their email address.
  • Test API ConnectivityTest endpoint for API connectivity.

Takes action

  • Post message to chatPost a message to a chat.
  • Send message to groupSends the given message to the specified recipients.
  • Upload File to RoamUpload a file to Roam so it can be sent as a chat attachment.
  • Add group membersAdd one or more group members and/or admins to an existing Roam group.
  • Add Reaction to MessageAdd an emoji reaction to a message in a chat.
  • Create GroupCreate a group address that can be used for chat.
  • Create Roam SCIM GroupCreate a new group in your Roam organization using SCIM 2.0.
  • Create Roam UserCreate a new user in Roam via SCIM 2.0 protocol for automated user provisioning.
  • Delete Roam GroupArchive a group in Roam using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Delete Roam UserArchive a user in Roam using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
Show 7 more
  • Patch a groupPartially updates a group using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Patch user (SCIM)Partially updates a user using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Remove group membersRemove one or more members from a group in your Roam workspace.
  • Replace Roam SCIM GroupFully replaces a group's attributes using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Replace Roam UserFully replaces (updates) a user's attributes in Roam via SCIM 2.0 protocol.
  • Send Typing IndicatorNotify other chat participants that you are typing.
  • Update a meeting linkUpdate settings for an existing meeting link in Roam.
